japanese-published-study-material.label: Tier 1 - Japanese-published study material
japanese-published-study-material.description: Japanese-published JLPT preparation materials or manually reviewed consensus from those materials.
japanese-published-study-material.notes: Required for passing source confidence. Do not copy copyrighted lists; record reviewed level judgments and permitted citations only.

community-legacy-jlpt.label: Tier 2 - Legacy/community JLPT list
community-legacy-jlpt.description: Community-maintained JLPT lists with legacy or observed-test basis.
community-legacy-jlpt.notes: Useful for triangulation, never sufficient alone.

community-jlpt-study.label: Tier 2 - Community JLPT study list
community-jlpt-study.notes: Useful as one independent signal after license and extraction review.

dictionary-learning-platform.label: Tier 3 - Dictionary or learning platform
dictionary-learning-platform.description: Dictionary or learning-platform metadata that assigns or tags kanji by JLPT level.
dictionary-learning-platform.notes: Use as supporting evidence after source terms are reviewed.

frequency-and-jlpt-platform.label: Tier 3 - Frequency and JLPT platform
frequency-and-jlpt-platform.description: Corpus/frequency-oriented metadata that may include JLPT tags.
frequency-and-jlpt-platform.notes: Frequency is a sanity signal, not an automatic JLPT level assignment.

learning-platform.label: Tier 3 - Learning platform
learning-platform.description: Structured learning-platform metadata that may include JLPT tags or comparable level signals.
learning-platform.notes: Use only after license and API/export terms are reviewed.

official-japanese-background.label: Background - Official Japanese metadata
official-japanese-background.description: Official Japanese metadata such as Joyo status or school grade.
official-japanese-background.notes: Useful for sanity checks but not a direct JLPT assignment.

high.label: High confidence
high.releaseMeaning: Consensus is source-backed, includes the required Japanese-published evidence, and meets the high agreement threshold.
requirements: At least three unique independent voting source groups
At least one Japanese-published voting source
Agreement score greater than or equal to the high threshold
No disputed consensus or contract mismatch

standard.label: Standard confidence
standard.releaseMeaning: Consensus is source-backed and meets the standard agreement threshold, but not the high threshold.
requirements: At least three unique independent voting source groups
At least one Japanese-published voting source
Agreement score greater than or equal to the standard threshold
No disputed consensus or contract mismatch

weak.label: Weak confidence
weak.releaseMeaning: Some evidence exists, but independence, Japanese-published evidence, or agreement is insufficient.
requirements: Add reviewed Japanese-published source evidence when missing
Resolve weak agreement before release claims

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.releaseMeaning: Voting source groups do not produce a single consensus level.
requirements: Make an explicit keep/change/defer decision before relying on level placement

missing.label: Missing evidence
missing.releaseMeaning: No reviewed active voting source assignment exists for this kanji.
requirements: Add reviewed source assignments before claiming source confidence

tanos.name: Tanos JLPT resources
tanos.notes: Useful as one legacy/community signal. Tanos describes new JLPT level counts as estimated from JEES documentation; do not treat as sole authority.

jlptsensei.name: JLPT Sensei kanji lists
jlptsensei.notes: Useful as one independent web-study signal once source extraction and license review are complete.

kanshudo.name: Kanshudo usefulness/JLPT kanji data
kanshudo.notes: Use only after license and extraction terms are reviewed.

jpdb.name: jpdb kanji metadata
jpdb.notes: Frequency is a sanity signal, not an automatic JLPT level assignment.

wanikani.name: WaniKani kanji metadata
wanikani.notes: Use only after license and API/export terms are reviewed.

japanese_textbook_consensus.name: Japanese-published textbook consensus
japanese_textbook_consensus.notes: Manual evidence bucket for Japanese-published study materials such as Shin Kanzen Master, Sou Matome, and TRY. Do not copy copyrighted lists; record reviewed level judgments and citations only where permitted.

joyo_grade.name: Joyo kanji grade metadata
joyo_grade.notes: Official background metadata for sanity checks; school grade is not a JLPT assignment and must not vote directly in consensus.
